Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the intro earlier. We're ready to start the SSO + SCIM onboarding. A few constraints from our side:

- Production cutover needs to happen in a maintenance window (US-PST) between 8pm-11pm PT.
- We require a rollback window (minimum 60 minutes) and a plan for immediate revert if anything breaks.
- Our security team needs the exact egress IPs to whitelist and confirmation of the SCIM and service-account scopes.

Attached are the initial artifacts: finovate_sso_metadata.xml, finovate_scim_creds.txt, and finovate_firewall_ips.txt (small text lists).

Can your team confirm which items you need from us, and propose a mutual action plan with owners?

Best,
Alice Chen\Head of IT Operations\Finovate Corp

Alice — thanks for the files and the constraints. Short answer: yes, we can work within your maintenance window and support a 60-minute rollback. Below is a proposed mutual action plan and the initial owner assignments. I attached an implementation matrix (implementation-matrix-v1.csv) for tracking.

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 0: Confirm SAML metadata + test IdP in staging (Owner: Vanessa)
- Week 1: Configure SCIM & service account permissions; test provisioning (Owner: Monica)
- Week 2: Scheduling + pre-cutover validation; firewall whitelisting (Owner: Finovate IT + Redwood Netops)
- Cutover day: 20:00 PT start; 60-minute rollback window; post-cutover validation (Owner: Vanessa / Alice)

Config items we need from you ASAP:
- Confirm SSO SAML entityID and ACS URLs (metadata looked good but we need explicit confirmation)
- Confirm SCIM base URL and service account username (we saw the creds file but need confirmation of exact service account email and scope)
- Confirm the single IP you will assign for outbound NAT from your environment if applicable (we will provide our egress list to you to add into your allowlist)

Technical notes:
- SCIM: Redwood expects PATCH support and group membership sync for role mapping. If your SCIM endpoint requires client certs let us know immediately.
- Service accounts: minimum scopes: scim:write, scim:read, users:read

Next steps: I will pull in our infra engineer and Karhtik from platform to clarify kernel-level egress and rollback hooks. If that works, propose a 30-minute technical call tomorrow at 11am PT.

Thanks — talk soon.

Vanessa Ortiz\Senior Customer Success Manager\Redwood Inference
[Attachment: implementation-matrix-v1.csv (CSV)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Eng Ops <engineering@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PS/CS Handshake: Access boundaries, SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist, rollback window

Vanessa / team — adding a few platform-level constraints and the immediate engineering owners.

1) SAML specifics:
- We need the exact Audience (SP EntityID) and full ACS list; please confirm if you use multiple ACS endpoints for mobile or proxy flows.
- If you are sending NameID as transient/unspecified we need mapping guidance (email preferred).

2) SCIM and service account:
- The service account should be a dedicated machine account (no human MFA) with the username format: scim-finovate@finovate.com.
- Required scopes on our side: scim:read, scim:write, groups:read. We will limit the token lifetime to 24 hours for provisioning, but for the cutover we can increase to 7 days with an auditable key rotation.

3) IP allowlist and egress:
- For outbound traffic from Redwood to your SCIM/IdP endpoints we will use our netops egress pool. Please confirm you can whitelist the finovate_firewall_ips.txt set you sent; we will also provide an explicit list of Redwood egress IPs by EOD today.

4) Rollback / safety hooks:
- Platform can disable SSO at the tenant routing layer and fall back to email/password state within the 60-minute rollback window. We will coordinate DB-backed feature flags to flip back quickly.
- Eng Ops contact for cutover: eng-oncall@redwood.com (pager rotated). Attached is the JIRA reference for the cutover playbook: SUP-4952.

I'll join the 11am PT call; Monica to lead the SCIM testing plan.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer\Platform Lead, Serving Runtime\Redwood Inference
[Related: JIRA-ISSUE: SUP-4952]
